description: A ground-level photograph depicting a wide expanse of Pannonian dry grasslands in Northwestern Hungary under a predominantly cloudy sky. The landscape features undulating terrain covered with dry, yellowish-brown grass and sparse, low-lying shrubs, characteristic of a semi-natural grassland ecosystem. In the far distance, a single tall, slender mast or pylon is visible on the horizon. The bottom left corner of the image includes the attribution: "©Eurostat, 2012. LUCAS." (Land Use/Cover Area Frame Survey).
